payload.claim: DESIGN.md §5.6's second paragraph (already committed, adjacent to the paragraph the spec quotes) says the ledger's rebuttal fact now covers each anchored concern as well as each confirmed blocker, and that "the morning queue counts the last two apart from a sustained blocker" — which, read with CONTEXT.md's amended Rebuttal entry, can be read as saying the queue's unread/unanswered counts should span concerns too. The spec's own Out of scope section explicitly keeps saffron/cell/session.py:3721-3722's unread/unanswered counts per-blocker only, deferring that widening. This is probably an intentional, explicitly-flagged descoping (and is consistent with §6's unchanged blocker-only wording), but it leaves the just-amended DESIGN.md paragraph reading as if it already describes behavior this spec deliberately does not build. A person should confirm the descoping is intended before a cell spends money on it.
